verdict.rationale: The IRS offers online tax services such as accounts, transcripts and the Tax Withholding Estimator, so AI-generated insights from a user's data are a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence documents any AI-generated insight or suggestion feature. The Withholding Estimator is a deterministic calculator, not an AI feature, and the probes show no AI-facing surfaces.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
